status: internal protocol fixed before model holdout evaluation; not an external preregistration
source_snapshot: Flickr original IJCAI15 archive and Wikidata snapshot 2026-10-26
task: next distinct cultural attraction in the current city; non-cultural visits are skipped
scope: manually audited named cultural attractions, not an exhaustive statutory heritage register
temporal_split: whole source sequences ordered by end timestamp within city; first 60% train, next 20% validation, last 20% test, boundary ties assigned to earlier split
overlap_rule: quarantine any sequence with overlapping time interval for the same user; never use a previous sequence that ends at or after current start
ambiguous_time_rule: exclude entire source sequence if distinct canonical attractions share a photograph timestamp
main_eligibility: at least 3 earlier cultural visits in completed sequences and at least 2 distinct consecutive cultural visits already observed in current prefix
cold_start_evaluation: secondary all next-cultural events with a nonempty current prefix, including users without prior sequences
candidates: all included city attractions except current last attraction; repeat returns to older attractions allowed; no sampled negatives
primary_metric: user-macro NDCG@5; each city weighted equally for pooled validation selection
metadata_time_assumption: retrospective static descriptive metadata; excludes future event/status and inception-century features; does not claim knowledge was available online in 2012
graphs: weighted undirected bipartite POI to typed feature nodes; class edges in every graph; cultural edges only for selected properties; personal PageRank from item seed; remove diagonal and row-normalize item kernel
backbone: shrunken ItemKNN cosine on binary training user-item interactions; no refit after validation
gate: alpha_min + (alpha_max-alpha_min)*TV(flat cultural feature profile S, profile L)*n/(n+c); only alpha_max>alpha_min; base graph and mixing parameters held fixed at CulturalFixed validation selection
external_selection: Edinburgh is not used in any hyperparameter selection; train local behavioural kernels on its training period, transfer selected hyperparameters
drift_stratum: TV between independently manually assigned functional categories of L and S; cutoff is 75th percentile of eligible training contexts in main cities; computed from prefixes only

hypotheses.H1: CulturalFixed versus CategoryFixed in main test cities; CulturalFlatFixed is an information-matched control
hypotheses.H2: CulturalAdaptive versus CulturalFixed in high-drift eligible main test contexts; all-context result also reported

uncertainty: paired cluster bootstrap by global Flickr user with weights shared across cities, city-macro mean, 10000 draws, percentile 95% interval; paired sign-permutation test with a shared sign per global user, 10000 draws; Holm adjustment across two primary hypotheses
robustness: fixed selected hyperparameters; properties removed individually; 20 degree-preserving within-property edge shuffle seeds; 10 edge dropout seeds for fractions .1,.25,.5; earlier-date inclusion and stricter date cutoff as sensitivity without retuning
tie_breaking: score descending then training popularity descending then canonical POI ID ascending; no test popularity
interpretation: failure to improve is reported without post-hoc model selection
